name: Peterson Farm
tagline: Peterson Farm in Sophia, North Carolina
description: Peterson Farm is a working pumpkin patch in Sophia, NC. It grows Pumpkins, Squash, Corn, Tomatoes, and Peppers, with picking through autumn, summer, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Sep – Nov in this growing zone.
